topics.description_sl: FIFA, UEFA, nacionalne zveze, njihovi sedeži, predsedniki, pristojnosti in organizacijska zgodovina.
topics.description_en: FIFA, UEFA and national associations, including their seats, leaders, responsibilities and organisational history.
topics.inclusion: Use when a football governing institution or its official is the tested knowledge.
topics.exclusion: Exclude refereeing decisions during a match, club management and general international organisations.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži nogometne zveze s sedeži, vodstvom, pristojnostmi, tekmovanji in zgodovinskimi mejniki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect football associations with seats, leaders, responsibilities, competitions and historical milestones.

topics.label_sl: Nogometna pravila, sojenje, oprema in tehnologija
topics.label_en: Football rules, officiating, equipment and technology
topics.description_sl: Pravila igre, sodniško izrazje, prekrški, prekinitve, oprema, igralni običaji in tehnologija VAR.
topics.description_en: Laws of the game, officiating terms, fouls, restarts, equipment, match customs and VAR technology.
topics.inclusion: Use when the question tests how football is played, officiated or equipped.
topics.exclusion: Exclude careers, tournament results, governance and supporter culture.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi pravila, sodniške znake, prekinitve, prekrške, igralno opremo, običaje in tehnologijo VAR.
topics.study_focus_en: Review rules, referee signals, restarts, fouls, equipment, customs and VAR technology.

topics.label_sl: Prepoznavanje rastlin, ljudska imena in vrste
topics.label_en: Plant identification, common names and species
topics.description_sl: Prepoznavanje rastlin po videzu, plodovih, ljudskih imenih, sopomenkah in vrstni pripadnosti.
topics.description_en: Identification of plants by appearance, fruit, common names, synonyms and species identity.
topics.inclusion: Use when the central task is naming or recognising a plant or matching its common and formal names.
topics.exclusion: Exclude plant physiology, crop production, culinary preparation and medicinal use as the primary fact.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži rastline z ljudskimi in strokovnimi imeni, videzom, plodovi ter prepoznavnimi značilnostmi.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect plants with common and formal names, appearance, fruit and identifying traits.

topics.description_sl: Deli rastlin, fotosinteza, rast, cvetenje, razmnoževanje, življenjski cikli in botanična razvrstitev.
topics.description_en: Plant structures, photosynthesis, growth, flowering, reproduction, life cycles and botanical classification.
topics.inclusion: Use when a biological process, plant structure or taxonomic relationship is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude simple species identification, crop varieties and traditional medicinal use.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi rastlinske organe, fotosintezo, rast, cvetenje, razmnoževanje in osnovno botanično razvrstitev.
topics.study_focus_en: Review plant organs, photosynthesis, growth, flowering, reproduction and basic botanical classification.

topics.label_sl: Užitne, kulturne in gospodarsko uporabne rastline
topics.label_en: Edible, cultivated and economically useful plants
topics.description_sl: Sadne sorte, zelenjava, žita, stročnice, začimbnice in rastline za pijače, vlakna ali druge izdelke.
topics.description_en: Fruit cultivars, vegetables, cereals, pulses, spices and plants used for drinks, fibres or other products.
topics.inclusion: Use when a cultivated plant, edible variety or practical plant-derived product is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude recipes, medicinal herbs, wild-species identification and farming practice itself.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži kulturne rastline s sortami, užitnimi deli, pridelki, surovinami in gospodarsko uporabo.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect cultivated plants with varieties, edible parts, crops, raw materials and practical uses.

topics.description_sl: Zdravilna zelišča, dišavnice, njihove učinkovine, ljudska imena, uporaba in nevarne zamenjave.
topics.description_en: Medicinal herbs and aromatic plants, their active properties, common names, uses and dangerous lookalikes.
topics.inclusion: Use when medicinal, aromatic or traditional therapeutic use of a plant is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude general pharmacology, culinary technique and plant identity without a medicinal or aromatic context.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži zdravilne in aromatične rastline z imeni, učinkovinami, uporabo ter značilnimi opozorili.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect medicinal and aromatic plants with names, properties, uses and characteristic cautions.

topics.label_sl: Lega, identiteta in zgodovina svetovnih mest
topics.label_en: Location, identity and history of world cities
topics.description_sl: Državna in regionalna lega mest, nekdanja imena, velikost, pristaniška vloga in osnovna urbana identiteta.
topics.description_en: National and regional location, former names, size, port role and basic identity of world cities.
topics.inclusion: Use when the city itself, its location, name, size or broad identity is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude a specific landmark, institution, street, district or architectural design.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži mesta z državami, regijami, nekdanjimi imeni, prebivalstvom in značilnimi vlogami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect cities with countries, regions, former names, population and characteristic roles.

topics.label_sl: Mestne znamenitosti, ulice in četrti po svetu
topics.label_en: Urban landmarks, streets and districts around the world
topics.description_sl: Lega prepoznavnih mestnih spomenikov, trgov, ulic, četrti, pokopališč in turističnih točk.
topics.description_en: Locations of recognisable urban monuments, squares, streets, districts, cemeteries and tourist sites.
topics.inclusion: Use for location or identity of an urban landmark, street or district when design authorship is not tested.
topics.exclusion: Exclude architectural style or architect, city-wide identity and institutional function.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži znamenitosti, trge, ulice in četrti z mesti ter njihovim položajem v mestnem prostoru.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect landmarks, squares, streets and districts with cities and their urban location.

topics.label_sl: Mestne ustanove, promet in infrastruktura po svetu
topics.label_en: Urban institutions, transport and infrastructure worldwide
topics.description_sl: Univerze, sedeži ustanov, letališča, pristanišča, podzemne železnice in druga mestna infrastruktura.
topics.description_en: Universities, institutional seats, airports, ports, underground railways and other urban infrastructure.
topics.inclusion: Use when a city is tested through the location or role of an institution or infrastructure system.
topics.exclusion: Exclude the institution's internal purpose, transport technology and landmark architecture.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži mesta z univerzami, sedeži ustanov, letališči, pristanišči in prometnimi sistemi.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect cities with universities, institutional seats, airports, ports and transport systems.

topics.label_sl: Prometna pravila, znaki in cestna varnost
topics.label_en: Road rules, signs and traffic safety
topics.description_sl: Prometni znaki, semaforji, prednost, omejitve, stran vožnje, obvezna oprema in ravnanje ob nesreči.
topics.description_en: Road signs, traffic lights, priority, speed limits, driving side, mandatory equipment and accident response.
topics.inclusion: Use when a rule of road use, sign meaning or immediate safety practice is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude driver licensing documents, route geography, passports and vehicle manufacture.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi oblike in pomene znakov, semaforje, omejitve, prednostna pravila, obvezno opremo in varnostne postopke.
topics.study_focus_en: Review sign shapes and meanings, traffic lights, limits, priority rules, mandatory equipment and safety procedures.

topics.label_sl: Vozniška in prometna dokumentacija ter zavarovanje
topics.label_en: Driving and vehicle documents and insurance
topics.description_sl: Vozniška dovoljenja, kategorije, prometna dovoljenja, registracija, avtomobilsko zavarovanje in usposabljanje voznikov.
topics.description_en: Driving licences, categories, vehicle registration documents, motor insurance and driver training.
topics.inclusion: Use when a document, licence category, registration or insurance requirement for road vehicles is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude traffic-sign meanings, passports, visas and general legal procedure.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži vozniške kategorije, prometna dovoljenja, registracijo in zavarovalne dokumente z njihovim namenom.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect driving categories, vehicle documents, registration and insurance papers with their purposes.

topics.label_sl: Potni listi, vizumi in mejne formalnosti
topics.description_sl: Potni listi, osebni dokumenti za prehod meje, vizumi, vstopni pogoji in mejni postopki.
topics.description_en: Passports, identity documents for border crossing, visas, entry requirements and border procedures.
topics.inclusion: Use when international entry permission or the travel document shown at a border is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude driving documents, vehicle insurance, immigration politics and ordinary road rules.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi vrste potovalnih dokumentov, vizumske zahteve, vstopne pogoje in osnovne mejne postopke.
topics.study_focus_en: Review travel-document types, visa requirements, entry conditions and basic border procedures.

topics.description_sl: Poimenovane ceste, avtocestni odseki, izvozi, prelazi, počivališča, serpentine in cestne razdalje.
topics.description_en: Named roads, motorway sections, exits, passes, service areas, hairpin bends and road distances.
topics.inclusion: Use when a specific route, road location, distance or piece of road infrastructure is tested.
topics.exclusion: Exclude traffic rules, generic city streets, vehicle technology and hiking trails.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži ceste in avtoceste z izhodi, počivališči, prelazi, razdaljami in kraji ob poti.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect roads and motorways with exits, service areas, passes, distances and places along the route.

topics.description_sl: Zahodni in kitajski zodiak, astrološka znamenja, rojstna obdobja, simboli in osnovni horoskopski cikli.
topics.description_en: Western and Chinese zodiacs, astrological signs, birth periods, symbols and basic horoscope cycles.
topics.inclusion: Use when an astrological sign, zodiac system or horoscope cycle is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude astronomy, divination methods other than astrology and mythological stories.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi znamenja zahodnega in kitajskega zodiaka, njihova obdobja, simbole in cikle.
topics.study_focus_en: Review Western and Chinese zodiac signs, their periods, symbols and cycles.

topics.label_sl: Nadnaravna bitja, vraže in ljudska verovanja
topics.label_en: Supernatural creatures, superstitions and folk beliefs
topics.description_sl: Vampirji, volkodlaki, pošasti, znamenja sreče ali nesreče ter vsakdanje vraže.
topics.description_en: Vampires, werewolves, monsters, signs of luck or misfortune and everyday superstitions.
topics.inclusion: Use when a supernatural creature, superstition or folk belief is the tested knowledge.
topics.exclusion: Exclude named folk heroes and legends, formal religious doctrine, astrology and authored fantasy.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži nadnaravna bitja in vraže z njihovimi lastnostmi, obrambami, simboli ter znamenji sreče ali nesreče.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect supernatural creatures and superstitions with traits, defences, symbols and signs of luck or misfortune.

topics.description_sl: Kralj Matjaž, Peter Klepec, Robin Hood, lokalne pripovedi, kraji in simbolni predmeti ljudskega izročila.
topics.description_en: King Matthias, Peter Klepec, Robin Hood, local narratives, places and symbolic objects in folk tradition.
topics.inclusion: Use when a named traditional legend, folk hero, legendary deed or associated place is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude anonymous superstitions, ancient mythology and authored literary plots.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži ljudske junake z legendami, kraji, dejanji, nasprotniki in značilnimi simboli.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect folk heroes with legends, places, deeds, adversaries and characteristic symbols.

topics.description_sl: Tarot, prerokbe, hiromantija, šamanizem in drugi postopki domnevnega napovedovanja ali razkrivanja skritega.
topics.description_en: Tarot, prophecy, palmistry, shamanism and other practices said to predict events or reveal hidden knowledge.
topics.inclusion: Use when a method, practitioner or object of divination is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude astrology, ordinary religious ritual and supernatural creatures without a divinatory practice.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži vedeževalske prakse z njihovimi pripomočki, izvajalci, znamenji in domnevnimi nameni.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect divinatory practices with tools, practitioners, signs and claimed purposes.

topics.description_sl: Sedanje in nekdanje valute, apoeni, podobe, napisi in države uporabe kovancev ter bankovcev.
topics.description_en: Current and former currencies, denominations, imagery, inscriptions and countries using coins and banknotes.
topics.inclusion: Use when currency identity, denomination or physical money design is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude banking services, cryptocurrency, macroeconomics and commercial transactions.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži valute z državami, apoene s podobami ter nekdanji denar z obdobji uporabe.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect currencies with countries, denominations with imagery and former money with periods of use.

topics.description_sl: Bančni računi, kartice, dvigi, varčevanje, plačilne obveznosti, naložbe in digitalne valute.
topics.description_en: Bank accounts, cards, withdrawals, saving, payment obligations, investments and digital currencies.
topics.inclusion: Use when a banking service, personal financial state, investment or cryptocurrency is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude physical currency identification, taxation, macroeconomic indicators and retail terminology.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi bančne storitve, stanja na računih, načine varčevanja, plačilne obveznosti in glavne kriptovalute.
topics.study_focus_en: Review banking services, account states, saving methods, payment obligations and major cryptocurrencies.

topics.description_sl: Dražbe, cenovne politike, marže, popusti, borze, trgovske poti in izrazi prodaje blaga ali storitev.
topics.description_en: Auctions, pricing policies, margins, discounts, exchanges, trade routes and terms for selling goods or services.
topics.inclusion: Use when a market transaction, auction, retail custom or commercial term is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude personal banking, currency identity, taxation and macroeconomic theory.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži trgovske pojme z dražbami, oblikovanjem cen, popusti, borzami in načini prodaje.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect commercial terms with auctions, pricing, discounts, exchanges and methods of sale.

topics.label_sl: Evropska unija: ustanove, članstvo in politike
topics.label_en: European Union institutions, membership and policies
topics.description_sl: Ustanove EU, njihove pristojnosti in sedeži, članstvo, simboli, pogodbe, širitve ter skupne politike.
topics.description_en: EU institutions, responsibilities and seats, membership, symbols, treaties, enlargements and common policies.
topics.inclusion: Use when the European Union itself, an EU institution, treaty, membership fact or programme is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude non-EU organisations, national politics and euro currency design alone.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži ustanove EU s pristojnostmi in sedeži ter ponovi članstvo, pogodbe, simbole in ključne politike.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect EU institutions with powers and seats, and review membership, treaties, symbols and key policies.

topics.description_sl: Organi OZN, specializirane agencije, mirovne enote, sedeži, simboli, programi in mednarodni dnevi.
topics.description_en: UN bodies, specialised agencies, peacekeepers, seats, symbols, programmes and international observances.
topics.inclusion: Use when the United Nations or one of its agencies, bodies, missions or observances is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude NATO, EU institutions and independent non-governmental organisations.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži organe in agencije OZN z nalogami, sedeži, simboli, programi in mirovnimi operacijami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect UN bodies and agencies with functions, seats, symbols, programmes and peacekeeping operations.

topics.description_sl: Članstvo, sedeži, širitev, simboli, struktura in obrambna vloga zveze NATO ter sorodnih varnostnih zavezništev.
topics.description_en: Membership, seats, enlargement, symbols, structure and defence role of NATO and related security alliances.
topics.inclusion: Use when NATO or another formal interstate security alliance is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude United Nations peacekeeping, ordinary military organisation and football associations.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži varnostna zavezništva s članicami, sedeži, širitvami, organi in obrambnimi nalogami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect security alliances with members, seats, enlargement, bodies and defence roles.

topics.description_sl: OECD, Beneluks, višegrajska skupina, regionalne pobude in druge meddržavne organizacije zunaj EU, OZN ter NATO.
topics.description_en: The OECD, Benelux, Visegrád Group, regional initiatives and other interstate organisations outside the EU, UN and NATO.
topics.inclusion: Use when a non-EU, non-UN and non-NATO economic or regional interstate organisation is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude civic associations, commercial companies and informal geographic regions.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži mednarodne in regionalne organizacije s članicami, sedeži, namenom ter področjem sodelovanja.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect international and regional organisations with members, seats, purposes and fields of cooperation.

topics.description_sl: Liki, telesa, koti, stranice, diagonale, simetrija, geometrijski izreki in osnovna trigonometrija.
topics.description_en: Shapes, solids, angles, sides, diagonals, symmetry, geometric theorems and basic trigonometry.
topics.inclusion: Use when a geometric property, construction, theorem or trigonometric relation is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude unit conversion, arithmetic, statistics and physical measurement instruments.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi lastnosti likov in teles, vrste kotov, simetrijo, pomembne izreke in osnovna trigonometrična razmerja.
topics.study_focus_en: Review properties of shapes and solids, angle types, symmetry, major theorems and basic trigonometric ratios.

topics.description_sl: Dolžinske, površinske, prostorninske, masne in druge merske enote ter pretvarjanje med njimi.
topics.description_en: Units of length, area, volume, mass and other quantities, and conversions between them.
topics.inclusion: Use when recognising or converting a measurement unit is the main task.
topics.exclusion: Exclude geometric properties, calendar arithmetic and the function of a measuring instrument.
topics.study_focus_sl: Vadi pretvarjanje dolžine, površine, prostornine in mase med običajnimi merskimi enotami.
topics.study_focus_en: Practise converting length, area, volume and mass among common measurement units.

topics.description_sl: Matematične množice, statistični vzorci, opisni kazalniki, verjetnost in razlaga podatkov.
topics.description_en: Mathematical sets, statistical samples, descriptive measures, probability and interpretation of data.
topics.inclusion: Use when set theory, statistical sampling, a statistical measure or probability is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude arithmetic calculation, geometric shapes and rankings that merely cite a statistic.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi osnovne pojme množic, vzorčenja, statističnih kazalnikov, verjetnosti in razlage podatkov.
topics.study_focus_en: Review basic set, sampling, statistical measure, probability and data-interpretation concepts.

topics.description_sl: Znani morilci, gangsterji, mafijske združbe, razbojniki, kriminalni pari in njihove življenjske poti.
topics.description_en: Notorious killers, gangsters, mafia groups, outlaws, criminal couples and their biographies.
topics.inclusion: Use when a historical criminal, outlaw, gangster or organised-crime group is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude political assassinations, terrorist attacks, contemporary legal procedure and fictional criminals.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži kriminalce in združbe z vzdevki, kraji delovanja, sostorilci, dejanji in obdobjem.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect criminals and groups with nicknames, places, accomplices, deeds and historical periods.

topics.description_sl: Politični atentati, ugrabitve, teroristične organizacije, napadi, žrtve, storilci in zgodovinske okoliščine.
topics.description_en: Political assassinations, kidnappings, terrorist organisations, attacks, victims, perpetrators and historical context.
topics.inclusion: Use when an assassination, terrorist attack or politically motivated act of violence is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude conventional warfare, ordinary organised crime, legal punishment and accidental disasters.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži atentate in teroristične napade s storilci, žrtvami, kraji, organizacijami, datumi in posledicami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect assassinations and terrorist attacks with perpetrators, victims, places, organisations, dates and consequences.

topics.label_sl: Velike nesreče, požari in industrijske katastrofe
topics.label_en: Major accidents, fires and industrial disasters
topics.description_sl: Pomorske nesreče, veliki požari, jedrske in industrijske katastrofe, datumi, kraji, vzroki ter posledice.
topics.description_en: Maritime accidents, major fires, nuclear and industrial disasters, including dates, places, causes and consequences.
topics.inclusion: Use when an accidental disaster or destructive non-military event is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude deliberate attacks, natural-science mechanisms alone and routine transport safety.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži velike nesreče s kraji, datumi, plovili ali obrati, vzroki, žrtvami in posledicami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect major disasters with places, dates, vessels or facilities, causes, victims and consequences.

topics.description_sl: Sodni postopki, pravni izrazi, dokazovanje, sankcije, pomilostitve, dedovanje, sodni simboli in penologija.
topics.description_en: Court procedure, legal terminology, evidence, sanctions, clemency, inheritance, judicial symbols and penology.
topics.inclusion: Use when a legal concept, court institution, judicial procedure or penal system is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude police operations, intelligence agencies, traffic regulations and historical crimes as events.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi temeljne pravne pojme, sodne postopke, dokazna pravila, sankcije, pomilostitve in kaznovalni sistem.
topics.study_focus_en: Review core legal terms, court procedures, evidence rules, sanctions, clemency and penal systems.

topics.label_sl: Policija, nujne službe in varnostne agencije
topics.label_en: Police, emergency services and security agencies
topics.description_sl: Policijske naloge, klicne številke, identifikacija, Interpol, obveščevalne službe, gasilci in javnovarnostni postopki.
topics.description_en: Police duties, emergency numbers, identification, Interpol, intelligence services, firefighters and public-safety procedures.
topics.inclusion: Use when a police, emergency-response or intelligence institution, role or operational practice is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude court doctrine, military intelligence in wartime and ordinary first-aid technique.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži službe s pristojnostmi, klicnimi številkami, dokumenti, sedeži, simboli in postopki ukrepanja.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect services with responsibilities, emergency numbers, documents, seats, symbols and response procedures.

topics.description_sl: Vrste, zgradba, število nog, razvoj, vedenje in razvrščanje žuželk, pajkov ter klopov.
topics.description_en: Species, anatomy, leg counts, development, behaviour and classification of insects, spiders and ticks.
topics.inclusion: Use when an insect or arachnid species or its defining biology is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude crustaceans, molluscs, marine invertebrates and general animal anatomy spanning several groups.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži žuželke in pajkovce z zgradbo, razvojnimi stopnjami, vedenjem, življenjskim prostorom in razvrstitvijo.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect insects and arachnids with anatomy, development, behaviour, habitat and classification.

topics.description_sl: Polži, školjke, hobotnice, sipe, lignji ter njihova anatomija, dihanje, gibanje in vedenje.
topics.description_en: Snails, bivalves, octopuses, cuttlefish and squid, including anatomy, breathing, movement and behaviour.
topics.inclusion: Use when a mollusc, especially a cephalopod, or its biology is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude crustaceans, fish, cnidarians, echinoderms and generic marine geography.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi skupine mehkužcev ter značilnosti glavonožcev, njihove organe, dihanje, gibanje in obrambo.
topics.study_focus_en: Review mollusc groups and cephalopod anatomy, breathing, movement and defence.

topics.description_sl: Raki, korale, meduze, iglokožci in druge skupine morskih nevretenčarjev ter njihove značilnosti.
topics.description_en: Crustaceans, corals, jellyfish, echinoderms and other marine-invertebrate groups and their characteristics.
topics.inclusion: Use when a crustacean or non-molluscan marine invertebrate is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude fish, marine mammals, molluscs and insects.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži rake in druge morske nevretenčarje s skupinami, zgradbo, življenjskim okoljem in značilnimi prilagoditvami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect crustaceans and other marine invertebrates with groups, anatomy, habitats and adaptations.

topics.label_sl: Literarni pojmi, oblike in retorične figure
topics.label_en: Literary terms, forms and rhetorical figures
topics.description_sl: Literarne vrste in zvrsti, zgradba besedila, pesniške oblike, stopice, rima in retorične figure.
topics.description_en: Literary genres, text structure, poetic forms, metrical feet, rhyme and rhetorical figures.
topics.inclusion: Use when a formal literary term, poetic structure or rhetorical device is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude the plot of a specific work, author biography, literary awards and publishing events.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi literarne vrste, dele besedila, pesniške oblike, stopice, rimo in najpogostejše retorične figure.

topics.study_focus_en: Connect operating systems with devices and mascots, and applications with makers, file types and principal tasks.

topics.description_sl: Družbena omrežja, sporočilne in družabne platforme, njihove funkcije, zgodovina, omejitve objav, odzivi in spremembe imen.
topics.description_en: Social networks, messaging and social platforms, their functions, history, post limits, reactions and name changes.
topics.inclusion: Use when a social network, messaging service, dating platform or socially organised media platform and its conventions are central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude search engines, web browsers, general email, streaming as a media service, application software and company history unrelated to a platform.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži platforme z namenom, ustanovitelji, letnicami, lastništvom, omejitvami objav, odzivi in pomembnimi preimenovanji.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect platforms with purpose, founders, dates, ownership, post limits, reactions and major renamings.

topics.description_sl: Zgodovina, poimenovanje, razvoj in značilne storitve spletnih iskalnikov ter programov za brskanje po spletu.
topics.description_en: History, naming, development and characteristic services of web search engines and web-browsing software.
topics.inclusion: Use when a web search engine, image-search service or browser and its origin, name, era or competitive history is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude social networks, email services, general application software, website content and commercial branding without a search or browsing function.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži iskalnike in brskalnike z zgodnjimi imeni, letnicami, izdelovalci, značilnimi storitvami in razvojnimi prelomnicami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect search engines and browsers with early names, dates, makers, characteristic services and development milestones.

topics.label_sl: Slovensko letalstvo: letališča in letalski prevozniki
topics.description_sl: Slovenska letališča, njihova poimenovanja in zgodovina ter domači letalski prevozniki, predhodniki in mejniki delovanja.
topics.description_en: Slovenian airports, their names and history, and domestic airlines, predecessors and operational milestones.
topics.inclusion: Use when a Slovenian airport, its namesake or former name, a domestic airline or a milestone in Slovenian civil aviation is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude aircraft technology, foreign airlines, spaceflight and Slovenian road, rail or maritime infrastructure.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži letališča z lego, uradnimi in nekdanjimi imeni ter prevoznike z ustanovitvijo, preimenovanji in pomembnimi mejniki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect airports with location, official and former names, and airlines with founding, renamings and major milestones.

topics.label_sl: Slovenske železnice in mestni javni promet
topics.label_en: Slovenian railways and urban public transport
topics.description_sl: Železniške proge in zgodovina železnice v Sloveniji ter mestni avtobusi, trolejbusi in krajevna poimenovanja javnega prevoza.
topics.description_en: Railway routes and railway history in Slovenia, together with urban buses, trolleybuses and local public-transport terminology.
topics.inclusion: Use when Slovenian railway access or history, a named rail project, or a Slovenian urban public-transport system is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude airports and airlines, motorways, vehicle technology, traffic law and competitive cycling.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi razvoj železniških povezav, pomembne proge in projekte ter posebnosti mestnega avtobusnega in trolejbusnega prometa.
topics.study_focus_en: Review the development of railway links, major lines and projects, and distinctive features of urban bus and trolleybus systems.

topics.description_sl: Avtocestni kraki, oznake in povezave ter lega, število in pripadnost pomembnih slovenskih cestnih predorov.
topics.description_en: Motorway branches, designations and links, and the location, number and route membership of major Slovenian road tunnels.
topics.inclusion: Use when a named Slovenian motorway, motorway branch, road connection or road tunnel is the tested object.
topics.exclusion: Exclude traffic rules and signs, ordinary route calculation, railway tunnels, foreign road networks and vehicle manufacture.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži avtocestne oznake z glavnimi smermi in mesti ter predore z odseki, pokrajinami in povezavami, na katerih ležijo.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect motorway designations with principal directions and cities, and tunnels with the sections, regions and links on which they lie.

topics.label_sl: Slovenska industrijska podjetja, znamke in izdelki
topics.label_en: Slovenian industrial companies, brands and products
topics.description_sl: Slovenski proizvajalci in industrijske znamke, njihovi ustanovitelji, predhodniki, obrati, kraji proizvodnje in značilni izdelki.
topics.description_en: Slovenian manufacturers and industrial brands, their founders, predecessors, plants, production locations and characteristic products.
topics.inclusion: Use when a Slovenian manufacturing company, industrial brand, founder, predecessor, factory location or manufactured product is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude mining and energy infrastructure, airlines and airports, transport routes, general commercial logos and foreign manufacturers.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži podjetja in znamke z ustanovitelji, sedeži in obrati, predhodnimi imeni, obdobji delovanja ter značilnimi izdelki.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect companies and brands with founders, headquarters and plants, former names, operating periods and characteristic products.

topics.label_sl: Slovensko rudarstvo, energetika in težka industrija
topics.label_en: Slovenian mining, energy and heavy industry
topics.description_sl: Slovenski rudniki in surovine, železarstvo, glažute, elektrarne, skladišča energentov ter velika industrijska infrastruktura.
topics.description_en: Slovenian mines and resources, ironworking, glassworks, power stations, fuel storage and large industrial infrastructure.
topics.inclusion: Use when Slovenian extraction, heavy industrial production, energy generation or major associated infrastructure is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude consumer-product manufacturers, transport companies, geology without industrial use and general environmental science.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži rudnike z rudami in kraji, industrijske panoge z obrati ter elektrarne in energetsko infrastrukturo z letnicami in lokacijami.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect mines with resources and places, industries with plants, and power stations and energy infrastructure with dates and locations.

topics.description_sl: Časovno zaporedje likovnih obdobij ter značilnosti, poimenovanja in ključni ustvarjalci umetnostnih smeri in slogov.
topics.description_en: Chronology of visual-art periods and the characteristics, names and defining artists of movements and styles.
topics.inclusion: Use when identifying, distinguishing or sequencing an art period, movement or style is the central task.
topics.exclusion: Exclude identification of a single artwork or artist when no movement knowledge is required, art-making technique and architectural style tested through a building.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uredi obdobja in smeri po času ter jih poveži z značilnostmi, ključnimi umetniki in reprezentativnimi deli.
topics.study_focus_en: Order periods and movements chronologically and connect them with characteristics, defining artists and representative works.

topics.label_sl: Balet: dela, plesalci in odrska praksa
topics.label_en: Ballet works, dancers and stage practice
topics.description_sl: Klasični baleti, baletni plesalci in koreografi, položaji v ansamblu, oblačila, tehnika ter zgodovina baletnega odra.
topics.description_en: Classical ballets, ballet dancers and choreographers, company roles, clothing, technique and ballet stage history.
topics.inclusion: Use when a ballet work, dancer, choreographer, company role, costume or ballet-specific performance practice is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude social and competitive dance, opera, theatre institutions without a ballet focus and general performer biography.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži balete s skladatelji in zgodbami, plesalce s karierami ter ponovi vloge v ansamblu, oblačila in temeljne odrske tehnike.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect ballets with composers and stories, dancers with careers, and review company roles, clothing and core stage techniques.

topics.description_sl: Lastnosti kovin, sestava in poimenovanje zlitin, čistina, tališča, prevodnost ter temeljni metalurški postopki in izdelki.
topics.description_en: Properties of metals, alloy composition and naming, purity, melting points, conductivity and basic metallurgical processes and products.
topics.inclusion: Use when a metal as a material, an alloy, metal purity, comparative metal property or metallurgical classification is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude recognition of a chemical symbol alone, mineral geology, jewellery design and industrial-company history.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži kovine s fizikalnimi lastnostmi in uporabo ter ponovi sestavo zlitin, merjenje čistine, metalurške skupine in značilne izdelke.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect metals with physical properties and uses, and review alloy composition, purity measures, metallurgical groups and characteristic products.

topics.label_en: Temperature scales and changes of state
topics.description_sl: Celzijeva, Fahrenheitova in Kelvinova lestvica, absolutna ničla, vrelišče in ledišče ter prehodi med agregatnimi stanji.
topics.description_en: Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin scales, absolute zero, boiling and freezing points, and transitions between states of matter.
topics.inclusion: Use when temperature-scale interpretation, absolute zero, a boiling or freezing point, or a named physical change of state is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude weather temperatures, cooking technique, ordinary unit conversion without a thermal concept and chemical reactions that create a new substance.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi izhodišča in pretvorbe temperaturnih lestvic, absolutno ničlo, vrelišče in ledišče vode ter imena in smeri faznih prehodov.
topics.study_focus_en: Review temperature-scale reference points and conversions, absolute zero, water's boiling and freezing points, and the names and directions of phase changes.

topics.label_sl: Predsedniki ZDA, prve družine in Bela hiša
topics.label_en: U.S. presidents, first families and the White House
topics.description_sl: Predsedniško zaporedje in mandati v ZDA, politični in osebni mejniki predsednikov, prve dame in družine, predsedniške administracije, Bela hiša ter z njimi povezane navade in afere.
topics.description_en: U.S. presidential succession and terms, political and personal milestones of presidents, first ladies and families, presidential administrations, the White House and associated customs and scandals.
topics.inclusion: Use when a U.S. president, first lady or presidential relative, presidential succession or term, a member of a named presidential administration, the White House, or a presidency-specific custom, milestone or scandal is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude U.S. history without a presidential focus, state governors as such, foreign political leaders, general party and election systems, and attacks whose operational history rather than presidential chronology is tested.
topics.study_focus_sl: Uredi predsednike po zaporedju in mandatih ter jih poveži z volitvami, vojnami, atentati, odstopi, administracijami, prvimi damami, družinskimi podatki, Belo hišo, javnimi navadami in pomembnimi aferami.
topics.study_focus_en: Order presidents by succession and terms, and connect them with elections, wars, assassinations, resignations, administrations, first ladies, family facts, the White House, public customs and major scandals.

topics.description_sl: Športna in ritmična gimnastika, gimnastičarji, orodja in rekviziti, društva, tekmovanja ter zgodovinski dosežki.
topics.description_en: Artistic and rhythmic gymnastics, gymnasts, apparatus, clubs, competitions and historical achievements.
topics.inclusion: Use when artistic or rhythmic gymnastics, a gymnast, apparatus, gymnastics club, competition or discipline-specific achievement is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude general Olympic medal totals, school physical education, circus acrobatics and unrelated civic associations.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi gimnastične discipline, orodja in rekvizite ter pomembne tekmovalce, društva, tekmovanja in dosežke.
topics.study_focus_en: Review gymnastics disciplines and apparatus, and connect notable athletes, clubs, competitions and achievements.

topics.label_sl: Bowling in kegljanje: pravila, oprema in tekmovalci
topics.label_en: Bowling and nine-pin bowling rules, equipment and players
topics.description_sl: Bowling z desetimi keglji in klasično kegljanje z devetimi keglji, njuna postavitev, pravila, točkovanje, oprema in tekmovalci.
topics.description_en: Ten-pin bowling and nine-pin bowling, including pin arrangements, rules, scoring, equipment and players.
topics.inclusion: Use when ten-pin or nine-pin bowling, its players, pin count, equipment, scoring or competitive rules are central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude bocce, darts, billiards and questions in which bowling appears only as an answer distractor.
topics.study_focus_sl: Primerjaj bowling in kegljanje po številu in postavitvi kegljev, opremi, načinu točkovanja, pravilih ter pomembnih tekmovalcih.
topics.study_focus_en: Compare ten-pin and nine-pin bowling by pin arrangement, equipment, scoring, rules and notable competitors.

topics.description_sl: Tarča, sektorji, vrednosti metov, seštevanje točk, puščice, razdalje in tekmovalna pravila pikada.
topics.description_en: The dartboard, sectors, throw values, scoring, darts, distances and competitive rules of darts.
topics.inclusion: Use when darts, dartboard structure, maximum scores, throwing equipment or a rule of play is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude archery, shooting sports, billiards, board games and figurative references to hitting a target.
topics.study_focus_sl: Ponovi razdelitev tarče, vrednosti sektorjev in obročev, najvišje mogoče izide, opremo, razdalje in osnovna pravila igre.
topics.study_focus_en: Review board sectors and rings, maximum scores, equipment, throwing distances and core rules of play.

topics.label_sl: Biljard in snooker: pravila, krogle in oprema
topics.label_en: Billiards and snooker rules, balls and equipment
topics.description_sl: Različice biljarda in snookerja, število, barve in vrednosti krogel, miza, palice, začetna postavitev, točkovanje ter pravila.
topics.description_en: Billiards and snooker variants, the number, colours and values of balls, tables, cues, starting layouts, scoring and rules.
topics.inclusion: Use when billiards, pool or snooker, its balls, table, cues, scoring or rules are central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude darts, bowling, bocce, board games and questions in which a cue sport appears only as a distractor.
topics.study_focus_sl: Primerjaj biljardne igre po številu, barvah in vrednostih krogel, začetni postavitvi, opremi, cilju igre ter točkovanju.
topics.study_focus_en: Compare cue sports by ball counts, colours and values, starting layouts, equipment, objectives and scoring.

topics.label_sl: Namizni tenis: igralci, pravila in oprema
topics.label_en: Table tennis players, rules and equipment
topics.description_sl: Igralci, klubi in tekmovanja v namiznem tenisu, loparji, žogice, mize, mrežice, točkovanje ter športno izrazje.
topics.description_en: Table tennis players, clubs and competitions, together with bats, balls, tables, nets, scoring and terminology.
topics.inclusion: Use when table tennis, a player or club, competition, rule, term or piece of table-tennis equipment is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude lawn tennis, badminton, squash, casual table games and general Olympic medal totals.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži igralce in klube z dosežki ter ponovi opremo, mere igralne površine, način točkovanja in temeljna pravila.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect players and clubs with achievements, and review equipment, playing dimensions, scoring and core rules.

topics.description_sl: Bejzbolski igralci, ekipe, igralni položaji, število igralcev, oprema, pravila, tekmovanja, rekordi in pomembne športne kariere.
topics.description_en: Baseball players, teams, positions, roster size, equipment, rules, competitions, records and notable sporting careers.
topics.inclusion: Use when baseball, a player or team, playing position, team size, rule, record or baseball career is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude softball, cricket, American football and questions in which baseball is merely a distractor.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži igralce z ekipami in karierami ter ponovi sestavo moštva, igralne položaje, opremo, osnovna pravila in pomembna tekmovanja.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect players with teams and careers, and review team composition, positions, equipment, core rules and major competitions.

topics.description_sl: Tekmovalno jadranje, jadralni razredi, regate, posadke, plovila, oprema, tekmovalne proge in dosežki jadralcev.
topics.description_en: Competitive sailing, sailing classes, regattas, crews, boats, equipment, courses and sailors' achievements.
topics.inclusion: Use when competitive sailing, a sailor, sailing class, regatta, crew, boat or race rule is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude rowing, canoeing, kayaking, vessel technology, naval history and general knowledge about wind or weather.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži jadralne razrede s plovili in tekmovalci ter ponovi velike regate, sestavo posadk, opremo, proge in osnovna pravila.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect sailing classes with boats and athletes, and review major regattas, crews, equipment, courses and core rules.

topics.label_en: Formula One drivers, races and rules
topics.description_sl: Dirkači, moštva, prvenstva, velike nagrade, kvalifikacije, startna mesta, zastave, dirkalniki, rekordi in zgodovina Formule 1.
topics.description_en: Formula One drivers, teams, championships, Grands Prix, qualifying, grid positions, flags, cars, records and history.
topics.inclusion: Use when Formula One, a driver or team, championship, Grand Prix, qualifying procedure, race flag, car or record is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude motorcycle racing, rallying, endurance racing, other motorsport series and general vehicle technology without a Formula One focus.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži dirkače z moštvi, naslovi in rekordi ter ponovi velike nagrade, kvalifikacije, startni vrstni red, zastave in razvoj dirkalnikov.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect drivers with teams, titles and records, and review Grands Prix, qualifying, grid order, flags and car development.

topics.description_sl: Balvansko, težavnostno in hitrostno plezanje, tekmovalci, tekmovanja, točkovanje, plezalne stene, oprimki, oprema in dosežki.
topics.description_en: Bouldering, lead and speed climbing, athletes, competitions, scoring, climbing walls, holds, equipment and achievements.
topics.inclusion: Use when competitive sport climbing, a climber, discipline, competition, result, rule or sport-climbing equipment is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude mountaineering, alpinism, Himalayism, hiking and climbing-wall engineering without a sport-climbing fact.
topics.study_focus_sl: Primerjaj discipline po cilju in točkovanju ter poveži pomembne tekmovalce s prvenstvi, dosežki, prizorišči in opremo.
topics.study_focus_en: Compare disciplines by objective and scoring, and connect leading athletes with championships, achievements, venues and equipment.

topics.label_sl: Boks: boksarji, pravila in znameniti dvoboji
topics.label_en: Boxing fighters, rules and famous bouts
topics.description_sl: Boksarji, težnostne kategorije, udarci, runde, ring, oprema, pravila, prvenstva, življenjepisi in znameniti dvoboji.
topics.description_en: Boxers, weight classes, punches, rounds, rings, equipment, rules, championships, biographies and famous bouts.
topics.inclusion: Use when boxing, a boxer, weight class, punch, round, ring rule, piece of equipment, title or historical bout is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude mixed martial arts, wrestling, judo, karate, other combat sports and fictional boxing when a screen work is the knowledge target.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži boksarje z vzdevki, naslovi in znamenitimi dvoboji ter ponovi kategorije, udarce, trajanje rund, opremo in temeljna pravila.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect boxers with nicknames, titles and famous bouts, and review weight classes, punches, round lengths, equipment and core rules.

topics.description_sl: Judoisti, trenerji, težnostne kategorije, pasovi, meti, prijemi, kazni, točkovanje, tekmovanja in pomembni dosežki.
topics.description_en: Judoka, coaches, weight classes, belts, throws, holds, penalties, scoring, competitions and notable achievements.
topics.inclusion: Use when judo, a judoka or coach, technique, belt, weight class, rule, competition or achievement is central.
topics.exclusion: Exclude boxing, karate, wrestling, mixed martial arts and general Olympic medal totals without a judo-specific fact.
topics.study_focus_sl: Poveži judoiste in trenerje z dosežki ter ponovi pasove, kategorije, mete, prijeme, kazni, točkovanje in velika tekmovanja.
topics.study_focus_en: Connect judoka and coaches with achievements, and review belts, classes, throws, holds, penalties, scoring and major competitions.
